tokens.name: cs-bg
tokens.usage: Page background (warm ivory / warm charcoal). Keep large areas on bg, surface or chip.

tokens.name: cs-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the masthead, footer and table panels.

tokens.name: cs-chip
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: chips, code, progress tracks, hover rows, the active docs-nav item.

tokens.name: cs-border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Too faint for a control boundary: use cs-control.

tokens.name: cs-control
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, ghost buttons) and link underlines; at least 3:1 on chip.

tokens.name: cs-text
tokens.usage: Main text on bg, surface and chip.

tokens.name: cs-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, meta rows, table headings, inactive nav; 4.5:1 on bg, surface and chip.

tokens.name: cs-primary
tokens.usage: Cinema red: the one primary action per section, the brand mark, focus rings and the current-nav underline. Not for links or errors.

tokens.name: cs-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary buttons.

tokens.name: cs-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cs-primary fills (dark text on coral in dark mode).

tokens.name: cs-gold
tokens.usage: Occasional small accent: blockquote rules, progress-card top border, new-method markers. Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: cs-gold-strong
tokens.usage: In-flight fill (running progress) and change marks on charts; 3:1 on chip.

tokens.name: cs-gold-bg
tokens.usage: Highlight badge ground: live pill, step numbers, demo banner.

tokens.name: cs-gold-text
tokens.usage: Text on cs-gold-bg, and running/queued status text.

tokens.name: cs-series
tokens.usage: Your brand's data: its line, bar and row tint in every chart. Same as cs-data-1.

tokens.name: cs-data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, always your brand. Series take cs-data-1 to 4 in order, never cycled; a fifth or later folds into Other in cs-muted.

tokens.name: cs-data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (magenta). Adjacent pairs pass color-blind separation; in scatter plots and small multiples use only series 1 and 2.

tokens.name: cs-data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (violet).

tokens.name: cs-data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (teal).

tokens.name: cs-success
tokens.usage: Recommended / top-pick verdicts, done runs, accepted fixes.

tokens.name: cs-success-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges (accepted fixes).

tokens.name: cs-warning
tokens.usage: Mentioned verdicts, partial or over-budget runs, high priority, proposed fixes, downward trends.

tokens.name: cs-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and the warn callout.

tokens.name: cs-error
tokens.usage: Failed runs, errors, urgent priority. Absent is NOT an error: it is muted.

tokens.name: cs-error-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for urgent and error badges.

tokens.name: cs-seat-active
tokens.usage: Seat meter: filled seats and the baseline.

tokens.name: cs-seat-inactive
tokens.usage: Seat meter: outlined, unearned seats.

tokens.name: cs-seat-gold
tokens.usage: Seat meter: the third seat's fill for a top pick.

tokens.name: cs-seat-gold-stroke
tokens.usage: Seat meter: outline of the gold top-pick seat, so it reads on light grounds.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero headline only (36px under 800px wide).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Site page title. The app uses 28px (26px on narrow screens).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Site section heading. The app's is 18px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-heading; the app's card titles are 15px.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Big numbers in metric rows, with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Ask your buyers' questions of AI assistants and see whether they recommend you.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title, in cs-muted, max 720px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your prompts are plain text in your own repo, so they come with you.
styles.usage: Site and docs prose, max 768px wide.

styles.name: body-app
styles.sample: Recommended in 7 of 12 answers this week.
styles.usage: The app's base text: denser than the site.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Nav links, tables, docs nav, captions.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Meta rows, footers, section notes, in cs-muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above a heading, in cs-muted.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Table column headings, uppercase on the site, in cs-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks on cs-chip; inline code is 0.9em of its text.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: The app's pre blocks, ids and URLs (overflow-wrap: anywhere).

tokens.name: cs-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, list item gaps, chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: cs-space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and chips; table cell padding; button-row gap.

tokens.name: cs-space-3
tokens.usage: Compact gaps: meta rows, page-heading to lede.

tokens.name: cs-space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing, code block padding, small card padding.

tokens.name: cs-space-5
tokens.usage: App card padding; app page-heading margin.

tokens.name: cs-space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters, list rows, section headings.

tokens.name: cs-space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; featured card padding.

tokens.name: cs-space-12
tokens.usage: Hero grid gap; metric row column gap.

tokens.name: cs-space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom of main.

tokens.name: cs-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, focus-ring corners, progress tracks.

tokens.name: cs-control-radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, code blocks, screenshots.

tokens.name: cs-radius
tokens.usage: Cards, table panels, product previews.

tokens.name: cs-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the live pill, step-number discs.

shadow.note: Only floating layers get a shadow; cards use a border.

tokens.name: cs-shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus. Only floating layers get a shadow; cards use a border.

tokens.name: cs-shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Chart tooltips.

font.note: The type stacks under their codebase names.

tokens.name: cs-sans
tokens.usage: All UI and prose text. System fonts only: no web fonts are loaded.

tokens.name: cs-mono
tokens.usage: Code, ids, URLs and targets in fix rows.

tokens.name: cs-focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus ring: a solid cs-primary outline on every focusable element.

tokens.name: cs-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

tokens.name: cs-opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons.

tokens.name: cs-opacity-noise
tokens.usage: A change within noise: muted text at this opacity.

tokens.name: cs-content
tokens.usage: Max content width of the app and the masthead.

tokens.name: cs-prose
tokens.usage: Max width of site prose; docs prose is 720px.

tokens.name: cs-masthead
tokens.usage: Masthead min-height, shared by site and app.

tokens.name: cs-touch-target
tokens.usage: Min height of buttons, inputs and nav targets on coarse pointers.

breakpoint.note: Media queries repeat these as literals; the custom properties are for scripts and reference.

tokens.name: cs-bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: small phones (app nav icons hide; site under 400px). For scripts and reference: media queries repeat the literal.

tokens.name: cs-bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: phones (app nav wraps to its own row; site menu collapses at 720px).

tokens.name: cs-bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: tablets (fix facts wrap; hero tightens).

tokens.name: cs-bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: small laptops (app header drops the brand name and live pill).
